tax.text: He says he would support tax relief for D.C. residents and businesses to encourage economic growth.
tax.quote: D.C. needs policies that foster entrepreneurship, reduce overregulation, and provide tax relief to encourage business growth.

schools.text: He supports parental choice and says he would advocate for school choice programs while improving local education funding.
schools.quote: I believe in parental choice and the right to choose the best education for our children. I will advocate for school choice programs, improve local education funding, and work to make D.C.'s schools more competitive.

safety.text: Simmons says he stands with law-enforcement officers and supports strong public-safety policies.
safety.quote: I stand with our law enforcement officers and believe in strong policies that protect our neighborhoods.

schools.text: He opposed D.C. vouchers and urged federal education funds to support public schools.
schools.quote: I urge that those funds be pumped into the public schools where they will be most beneficial, and in that regard I appreciate the committee’s mark for Public and Charter School improvements.

safety.text: He favors community-based policing and opposes federal troop patrols, while saying police need more officers and resources.
safety.quote: Community-based policing is the most effective kind of policing. You need officers that understand the community. You need officers that are trusted by the community.
